name: Deon d'Lockes
source:
The eldest d'Lockes son. Infamous for his jokes and pranks (and flirty attitude), but he hasn't always sported this carefree personality. While he may seem immature and carefree on the outside, he keeps watch over his siblings and cares about them very much. Will he ever be able to show his true strengths when everyone tends to overlook him?

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=36483]Lemmasoft[/url]]
